summary: Four of six selected P21 F1 MBH-PoA genes had the same observed direction in the published qPCR means and the registered EDC-versus-vehicle RNA-seq coefficients. Drd1 and Crh had opposite signs. Figure S9 reports ontology enrichment, and the reviewed sources supplied no author gene-level F1 RNA-seq effects or inference.

manualReview.summary: Published P21 F1 qPCR means compared with registered RNA-seq effects for six genes
manualReview.note: Tables S3 and S5 give six P21 F1 female MBH-PoA qPCR means per treatment group, one for each target. Th, Dnm1, Darpp32 (Ppp1r1b) and Nr3c1 had lower EDC means and negative registered RNA-seq coefficients. Drd1 and Crh had higher EDC means and negative coefficients. The GEO family SOFT treatment fields identify the four vehicle and four EDC profiles. Both the SOFT and the counts TAR match the registered source hashes. The saved geo/series.html is a reCAPTCHA challenge. Figure S9 gives GO-term enrichment. Gene-level F1 RNA-seq effects and inference from the authors remain unassessed.
reviewFlags: The qPCR assay measured six animals per arm. Overlap with the sequenced animals and the RNA library-to-dam/litter mapping remain unknown.
The selected cross-assay panel falls below the 30-pair v2 minimum. Genome-wide author RNA-seq effects, P values and FDR remain unassessed.

verificationReview.reason: The authors measured the same P21 F1 tissue and exposure contrast by qPCR for six targets. Four point estimates agree in direction with registered edgeR-QL. Drd1 meets the reported qPCR threshold only and Crh meets the registered RNA-seq BH threshold only. Assay normalization and incomplete sample linkage limit interpretation of their opposite signs.
verificationReview.nextStep: Obtain the authors’ F1 edgeR results with tested identifiers, effects, raw and adjusted P values, the input count matrix, analysis settings and library-to-animal and litter assignments. The paper describes TopHat2 and featureCounts, while the GEO count tables have STAR ReadsPerGene format.

comparabilityReview.basis: Compare the sign and magnitude of each registered edgeR-QL log2 fold change with log2(EDC qPCR mean / control qPCR mean) for every F1 P21 MBH-PoA mRNA measurement in Figures 6A and S10A. Use the numerical means printed in Tables S3 and S5.
comparabilityReview.reference: López-Rodríguez et al., EHP8795, supplemental PDF ehp8795.s001.acco.pdf, Table S3 on PDF page 18 and Table S5 on PDF page 22. Figure 6A and Figure S10A identify the generation, age and mRNA assay. The preprint describes the same experiment.

cohort.note: Species, sex, age and anatomical dissection align. The qPCR panels use six animals per arm, with six litters per arm specified for Figure 6A. GEO treatment fields and the sample sheet document four F1 libraries per arm. Animal overlap and the RNA library-to-litter mapping are unknown.

contrast.note: Maternal-lineage EDC mixture relative to vehicle in the P21 F1 female MBH-PoA. Both effect signs use EDC minus control on a log2 scale. F3, other ages, cross-fostering, protein, methylation and chromatin measurements fall outside this comparison.

features.note: All six qPCR targets join uniquely to the registered table. Five use exact rat gene symbols. NCBI Gene 360616 records Darpp32 as an alias for Ppp1r1b. The RNA-seq testing universe used by the authors is unknown.

effects.note: The qPCR log2 ratios use rounded group means after efficiency-adjusted β-actin normalization and scaling to the control mean. The registered edgeR-QL coefficients use TMM-normalized libraries. Actb itself has registered log2FC +0.734170 (BH 0.00002146), so equal reference scaling across assays cannot be assumed. Four of six nonzero signs agree. Pearson is 0.599705, Spearman is 0.485714 and the median absolute log2 difference is 1.135646. The qPCR and RNA-seq values are +1.770 and −0.192 for Drd1, and +0.084 and −1.098 for Crh.

inference.note: Figure 6A specifies two-way ANOVA with Sidak comparisons. Table S5 labels the S10A values as P values. At 0.05, three targets meet the reported qPCR threshold and five meet the registered RNA-seq BH threshold. Drd1 has qPCR P = 0.016 and RNA-seq BH = 0.636. Crh has qPCR P = 0.82 and RNA-seq BH = 0.0124. Only Th and Dnm1 meet both assay thresholds. The original F1 RNA-seq P values and FDR are unavailable for comparison.

coverage.note: All six author-selected qPCR targets in Figures 6A and S10A were paired, covering 100% of that reference and 0.046472% of the 12,911 published registered genes. The registered BH family includes 14,587 tested rows, of which 1,676 had no mapped symbol and were withheld. Figure S9 reports F1 GO enrichment. The reviewed sources supplied no full F1 gene-level author RNA-seq table.

comparabilityReview.criteria: Include every P21 F1 mRNA target in Figures 6A and S10A, in the published treatment direction, regardless of significance. Author-concordance-v2 requires at least 30 pairs, at least 90% coverage of the relevant reference or output, and compatible cohort, contrast, identifiers and effect definitions. Either both correlations must reach 0.90, or at least 90% of nonzero pairs must agree in direction, with at least 30 nonzero pairs covering at least 90% of all pairs. Magnitude differences and assay-specific P values are descriptive.
comparabilityReview.conclusion: The selected qPCR and registered RNA-seq point estimates agree in direction for Th, Dnm1, Ppp1r1b and Nr3c1. Drd1 and Crh have opposite signs. The six pairs fall below the v2 minimum, and both numerical routes also fall below their agreement thresholds. The study’s original gene-level RNA-seq analysis remains unassessed.

computed.value: 6/6 uniquely matched and nonzero, 4/6 same direction. Opposite signs for Drd1 and Crh.

computed.claim: Cross-assay effect agreement on all six selected pairs
computed.value: Pearson 0.599705, Spearman 0.485714, median absolute log2 difference 1.135646, maximum 1.961588. The registered Actb reference-gene row has log2FC +0.734170 and BH 0.00002146.
6/12,911 published rows (0.046472%). The registered fit includes 14,587 rows, of which 1,676 were unmapped and unpublished.

qPCR reported P < 0.05 for Th, Dnm1 and Drd1. Registered BH < 0.05 for Th, Dnm1, Ppp1r1b, Nr3c1 and Crh. Of 6,864 BH calls among the published registered genes, 6,859 are outside the panel. The reviewed sources contain no original RNA-seq P or FDR pairs.

computed.claim: Deposited GEO files and registered cohort
computed.value: 16 sample count files, each with 32,883 Ensembl gene rows and three count columns. Eight F1 and eight F3 files. The four F1 libraries per arm match the registered sheet. The series matrix contains zero gene rows. The archive and SOFT support these counts and assignments. The saved GEO series HTML contains a browser challenge.

computed.claim: Fingerprint of the registered DE table

openIssues: The authors’ F1 RNA-seq effects, inference and tested gene universe were unavailable in the reviewed sources. The manuscript’s TopHat2/featureCounts description and GEO’s STAR-formatted counts leave the original analysis inputs uncertain.
Library-to-dam/litter assignments and overlap between sequenced animals and qPCR animals remain unknown.
